judge_edits.why: Contract: a replace must not include the line's surrounding quote character (events.ts uses '). The find is still unique without the quotes. The text is unchanged.

rulings.text: One craft name «El-Ahsa el işçiliği» (BL2-bisht-craft-r2), now also in the Qaisariyah body in “ ”. It is bounded by «sırma iplikle (yapılan) el nakışı» / «el işlemesi» in the same sentences, so it reads as embroidery. The reader's flag that the quoted label is unexplained: rejected, the same sentence explains it.
«Bişt yapım atölyeleri» is right for 'Bisht-making workshops'. It names the bisht and the making, and has no dokuma. The bare heading is the item's nature.

«elde işlenir» is right for 'hand-embroidered': işlemek is the Turkish verb of embroidery (nakış işlemek, cf. «işlenmiş nakışlarıyla» in souvenirs-list and «bişti işleyen aileler» in souvenirs-faq), and «elde» keeps the published idiom of the line. The reader retold it as 'hand-worked' and answered (c) correctly.
Cave: «yaz sıcağından korunmak için» (05) stands. Winter warmth kept (C16).

blind_disposition.disposition: in scope, accepted: summer-heat shelter read correctly. «Bu doğa olayı» stiffness is out of scope.
in scope, the unexplained-label flag on «“El-Ahsa el işçiliği”»: rejected (OR6d-tr-1). Sentence length, «hurma yaprağı ve çömlek işi», and bişt spelling variants (case forms) are out of scope.
in scope, accepted: «elde işlenir» (OR6d-tr-3). 'Approved by whom', «Genel olarak», and «Özgün» repetition are out of scope.
(a) embroidery, (b) summer heat, (c) never woven: all three rulings land.

out_of_scope: «Bu doğa olayı» stiff; «çok eski bir bekçi gibidir» (passage 1)
Long sentence «altın ya da gümüş kaplamalı … ayırt edilir»; «hurma yaprağı ve çömlek işi» reading as one thing (passage 2)
«mağazanın onaylı olduğundan» by whom; «Genel olarak bişt zanaatı»; «Özgün» repeated (passage 4)
note: No text change after the 06 read (the judge edit removes quote characters from find/replace only). The 06 read stands for final.json.
